hypotheses.justification: `hR` appears nowhere else in the statement, and the proof never refers to it. The proof names `hπ`, `hker`, `hψ`, `hXs`, `hX4`, `ht'` and `hX`, and gets `p.Prime` from `Fact.out`. Its only automation is `omega`, `ring` and `rw`/`show`, none of which can use a hypothesis of the form `IsNilpotent (p : R)`. The fact that p is zero mod p, which the proof does need, is supplied by `RhoLift.natCast_quot_eq_zero (p := p) R` in the quotient `R ⧸ pIdeal p R`, not by `hR`. So the existing proof works unchanged with `hR` deleted.

This instance follows from `[IsNoetherianRing R]` together with `hπ : Function.Surjective π`. Mathlib's `isNoetherianRing_of_surjective (R) (S) (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f) [IsNoetherianRing R] : IsNoetherianRing S` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Noetherian/Basic.lean) gives it. The proof does use Noetherianity of S, through the instance on `S ⧸ pIdeal p S` needed by `hasKernelOfDegree_map` and `HasKernelOfDegree.comp`. Adding `haveI := isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S π hπ` at the start of the proof recovers that instance, and the rest of the proof goes through unchanged. Nothing else in the statement mentions this instance.
